sb-tused.label: PBKS bowling innings using six or more bowlers, 2022–2026
sb-tused.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
sb-tused.query: WITH b AS (SELECT d.innings_id, d.bowler_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.bowler_id), r AS (SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY innings_id ORDER BY balls DESC, bowler_id) rk FROM b) SELECT CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (7,12) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, i.innings_id, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rk > 5 THEN r.balls ELSE 0 END) extraBalls, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rk > 5 THEN r.runs ELSE 0 END) extraRuns, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rk <= 5 THEN r.balls ELSE 0 END) coreBalls, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rk <= 5 THEN r.runs ELSE 0 END) coreRuns, MAX(r.rk) used, CASE WHEN m.winner_id = i.bowling_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won FROM r JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = r.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022 AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.innings_id
